prompts.title: Software Developer
prompts.prompt: Act as an experienced software developer. Help me design and implement [FEATURE] in [LANGUAGE/FRAMEWORK]. First identify the simplest robust approach, then provide readable production-quality code, edge cases, and a concise test plan.

prompts.title: Code Reviewer
prompts.prompt: Review the following code for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and unnecessary complexity. Prioritize issues by severity, explain why each matters, and propose the smallest safe fix. Code: [CODE]

prompts.title: Debugging Partner
prompts.prompt: Help me debug [PROBLEM]. Use the error, expected behavior, actual behavior, and relevant code I provide. Form hypotheses in probability order, tell me the fastest way to test each one, then recommend the minimal fix.

prompts.title: Technical Architect
prompts.prompt: Act as a pragmatic software architect. Design [SYSTEM] for [USERS/SCALE]. Optimize for simplicity, maintainability, security, cost, and development speed. Challenge unnecessary complexity and explain the key trade-offs.

prompts.title: Professional Writer
prompts.prompt: Rewrite [TEXT] for [AUDIENCE] with the goal of [GOAL]. Preserve the meaning and factual claims, improve clarity and flow, remove repetition, and use a [TONE] tone.

prompts.title: Concise Editor
prompts.prompt: Edit [TEXT] to make it substantially shorter without losing important meaning. Remove repetition, filler, vague language, and unnecessary qualifiers. Return only the polished version.

prompts.title: Story Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a compelling [GENRE] story about [PREMISE]. Use vivid but economical prose, believable characters, escalating tension, and a satisfying ending. Target length: [LENGTH].

prompts.title: Copywriter
prompts.prompt: Write conversion-focused copy for [PRODUCT] aimed at [AUDIENCE]. Lead with the strongest customer outcome, make benefits concrete, handle the main objection, and finish with a clear call to action.

prompts.title: Marketing Strategist
prompts.prompt: Act as a senior marketing strategist for [PRODUCT]. Target customer: [AUDIENCE]. Goal: [GOAL]. Recommend positioning, core message, acquisition channels, experiments, and success metrics. Prioritize by expected impact versus effort.

prompts.title: LinkedIn Post
prompts.prompt: Create a LinkedIn post about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Start with a strong non-clickbait hook, deliver one useful idea with concrete examples, keep paragraphs short, and end with a natural conversation prompt.

prompts.title: Landing Page
prompts.prompt: Create landing-page copy for [PRODUCT]. Audience: [AUDIENCE]. Include headline, subheadline, key benefits, how it works, objection handling, social-proof placeholders, and CTA. Optimize for clarity rather than hype.

prompts.title: Customer Persona
prompts.prompt: Build a practical customer persona for [PRODUCT/MARKET]. Focus on jobs-to-be-done, pains, desired outcomes, buying triggers, objections, alternatives, vocabulary, and where this person discovers solutions.

prompts.title: Research Analyst
prompts.prompt: Research [TOPIC] and produce a decision-oriented brief. Separate established facts from uncertainty, compare the strongest competing explanations or options, identify missing evidence, and finish with the most defensible conclusion.

prompts.title: Compare Options
prompts.prompt: Compare [OPTION A] and [OPTION B] for [USE CASE]. Define the decision criteria first, evaluate both against the same criteria, expose meaningful trade-offs, and recommend one based on [PRIORITIES].

prompts.title: Explain Simply
prompts.prompt: Explain [TOPIC] to someone with [LEVEL] knowledge. Start with the intuitive mental model, then explain how it works, give one concrete example, identify common misconceptions, and finish with the key takeaway.

prompts.title: Critical Thinker
prompts.prompt: Critically evaluate this claim: [CLAIM]. Identify assumptions, strongest supporting evidence, strongest counterarguments, alternative explanations, and what evidence would change the conclusion.

prompts.title: Image Prompt Builder
prompts.prompt: Create a detailed image-generation prompt for [SUBJECT]. Specify composition, environment, camera perspective, lighting, materials, color atmosphere, realism/stylization, and important constraints. Avoid contradictory visual instructions.

prompts.title: Product Photography
prompts.prompt: Create a premium product-photography prompt for [PRODUCT]. Define background, composition, lens perspective, key and fill lighting, material rendering, shadows, brand mood, and exact elements that must remain unchanged.

prompts.title: Portrait Prompt
prompts.prompt: Create a photorealistic portrait prompt for [SUBJECT]. Specify framing, expression, pose, lens, depth of field, skin detail, lighting setup, background, color grade, and identity-preservation constraints.

prompts.title: Isometric Scene
prompts.prompt: Create an isometric visual of [PLACE/SUBJECT] at roughly 30 degrees. Use layered geometry, readable depth, realistic materials, contact shadows, coherent scale, and a clean premium composition.

prompts.title: Video Concept
prompts.prompt: Develop a short-form video concept about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Provide hook, scene-by-scene structure, visual direction, narration/on-screen text, pacing, and final CTA. Target duration: [DURATION].

prompts.title: Cinematic Shot List
prompts.prompt: Create a cinematic shot list for [SCENE]. For each shot specify framing, camera movement, subject action, lighting, transition, and purpose. Keep visual continuity and production feasibility.

prompts.title: Meeting Action Plan
prompts.prompt: Turn these notes into an actionable plan: [NOTES]. Extract decisions, tasks, owners if stated, dependencies, deadlines if stated, unresolved questions, and the next three highest-priority actions.

prompts.title: Weekly Planner
prompts.prompt: Build a realistic weekly plan for [GOALS] given [CONSTRAINTS]. Prioritize outcomes, protect focused work, batch low-value tasks, include buffer time, and explicitly identify what should not be done this week.

prompts.title: Decision Framework
prompts.prompt: Help me decide between [OPTIONS]. Clarify the actual objective, define weighted decision criteria, distinguish reversible from irreversible consequences, compare opportunity costs, and make a clear recommendation.

prompts.title: Learn a Skill
prompts.prompt: Teach me [SKILL] from [CURRENT LEVEL] to [TARGET LEVEL]. Build a practical progression, explain only the theory needed for the next step, include exercises and feedback loops, and define measurable milestones.

prompts.title: Socratic Tutor
prompts.prompt: Tutor me on [TOPIC] using the Socratic method. Ask one question at a time, adapt difficulty to my answers, correct misconceptions clearly, and periodically test whether I can apply the concept independently.

prompts.title: Business Strategist
prompts.prompt: Act as a pragmatic business strategist for [BUSINESS]. Analyze customer problem, value proposition, differentiation, distribution, economics, risks, and the smallest experiments that can validate the biggest assumptions.

prompts.title: Startup MVP
prompts.prompt: Define the smallest credible MVP for [PRODUCT IDEA]. Identify the core user, painful problem, riskiest assumption, essential user loop, features to exclude, validation metric, and a fast low-cost launch plan.

prompts.title: Sales Discovery
prompts.prompt: Prepare a discovery-call framework for selling [PRODUCT] to [CUSTOMER]. Focus on current process, pain, business impact, urgency, decision process, alternatives, and qualification. Avoid leading questions.

prompts.title: API Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a clean API for [FEATURE]. Define resources, endpoints, request/response schemas, validation, errors, authentication, pagination where needed, and a minimal versioning strategy.

prompts.title: Test Engineer
prompts.prompt: Create a focused test plan for [FEATURE]. Cover happy paths, edge cases, failure modes, security-sensitive behavior, and the smallest high-value automated test suite.

prompts.title: Refactoring Coach
prompts.prompt: Refactor [CODE] without changing behavior. Identify the main maintainability problems, propose the smallest coherent refactor, and explain how to verify there are no regressions.

prompts.title: SQL Expert
prompts.prompt: Write and explain an efficient SQL solution for [TASK] using this schema: [SCHEMA]. Consider correctness, indexes, query cost, and edge cases.

prompts.title: Frontend UX Engineer
prompts.prompt: Implement [INTERFACE] with accessible, responsive behavior. Prioritize simple state management, semantic HTML, keyboard support, and mobile usability.

prompts.title: Security Review
prompts.prompt: Threat-model [SYSTEM/FEATURE]. Identify trust boundaries, likely abuse cases, sensitive data, authentication/authorization risks, and prioritized mitigations.

prompts.title: Email Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a concise email to [RECIPIENT] about [TOPIC]. Goal: [GOAL]. Keep it natural, specific, professional, and easy to respond to.

prompts.title: Tone Adapter
prompts.prompt: Rewrite [TEXT] in a [TONE] tone for [AUDIENCE]. Preserve facts and intent while adapting vocabulary, rhythm, directness, and formality.

prompts.title: Executive Summary
prompts.prompt: Turn [CONTENT] into an executive summary. Lead with the conclusion, retain material numbers and risks, remove background that does not affect the decision.

prompts.title: Proposal Writer
prompts.prompt: Draft a persuasive proposal for [CLIENT/PROJECT]. Explain the problem, proposed solution, scope, expected outcome, assumptions, and next step without unnecessary sales language.

prompts.title: Proofreader
prompts.prompt: Proofread [TEXT]. Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, awkward phrasing, and inconsistencies while preserving the author's voice.

prompts.title: Headline Generator
prompts.prompt: Generate 15 strong headlines for [TOPIC/OFFER] aimed at [AUDIENCE]. Vary the angle and keep them specific, credible, and non-clickbait.

prompts.title: Content Strategy
prompts.prompt: Build a 30-day content strategy for [BRAND] targeting [AUDIENCE]. Define 3-5 content pillars, formats, distribution, cadence, and measurable objectives.

prompts.title: SEO Brief
prompts.prompt: Create an SEO content brief for [KEYWORD/TOPIC]. Define search intent, audience questions, recommended structure, entities/concepts to cover, differentiation, and internal-link opportunities.

prompts.title: Ad Concepts
prompts.prompt: Create 10 advertising concepts for [PRODUCT] targeting [AUDIENCE]. For each give the angle, hook, core message, proof mechanism, and CTA.

prompts.title: Positioning
prompts.prompt: Develop positioning for [PRODUCT] in [MARKET]. Clarify target customer, category, alternative, differentiated value, reasons to believe, and a concise positioning statement.

prompts.title: Campaign Planner
prompts.prompt: Plan a campaign for [GOAL] with budget [BUDGET]. Recommend channels, creative concept, funnel, experiments, measurement, and stop/scale criteria.

prompts.title: Competitor Messaging
prompts.prompt: Compare the messaging of [COMPETITORS] for [MARKET]. Identify common claims, whitespace, customer language, and a differentiated messaging direction.

prompts.title: Source Evaluator
prompts.prompt: Evaluate these sources about [TOPIC]: [SOURCES]. Assess authority, recency, evidence quality, conflicts of interest, agreement, and unresolved uncertainty.

prompts.title: Market Research
prompts.prompt: Produce a market-research framework for [MARKET]. Cover customers, alternatives, market structure, trends, pricing, distribution, and the evidence needed before investing.

prompts.title: Literature Review
prompts.prompt: Synthesize the provided literature on [QUESTION]. Group findings by theme, distinguish consensus from disagreement, assess limitations, and identify research gaps.

prompts.title: Fact Checker
prompts.prompt: Fact-check [CLAIMS]. For each claim state supported, contradicted, uncertain, or unverifiable; explain the evidence required and flag ambiguous wording.

prompts.title: Interview Synthesizer
prompts.prompt: Analyze these interviews: [INTERVIEWS]. Extract recurring jobs, pains, desired outcomes, objections, language patterns, and surprising disagreements.

prompts.title: Data Interpreter
prompts.prompt: Interpret [DATA]. Identify the strongest patterns, plausible explanations, anomalies, limitations, and what additional analysis would most improve confidence.

prompts.title: Logo Concept
prompts.prompt: Create an image-generation prompt for a logo for [BRAND]. Brand attributes: [ATTRIBUTES]. Specify symbol concept, geometry, typography relationship, negative space, and constraints for scalability.

prompts.title: Architecture Visual
prompts.prompt: Create a photorealistic architectural visualization prompt for [BUILDING/SPACE]. Specify viewpoint, materials, landscaping, time of day, lighting, human scale, and realism constraints.

prompts.title: Poster Design
prompts.prompt: Design a premium poster prompt for [SUBJECT]. Define hierarchy, composition, typography zones, imagery, palette, texture, and print/editorial character.

prompts.title: Food Photography
prompts.prompt: Create a high-end food photography prompt for [DISH]. Specify plating, surface, props, lens, lighting direction, depth of field, texture, and appetizing realism.

prompts.title: Fashion Editorial
prompts.prompt: Create a fashion editorial prompt for [SUBJECT/OUTFIT]. Specify location, pose, styling, lens, lighting, composition, texture, and magazine-level art direction.

prompts.title: Thumbnail
prompts.prompt: Create a high-performing but credible thumbnail prompt for [TOPIC]. Define focal subject, expression/action, composition, contrast, background separation, and minimal text-safe space.

prompts.title: Video Script
prompts.prompt: Write a [DURATION] video script about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Use a strong opening, clear narrative progression, concrete examples, visual cues, and a concise ending.

prompts.title: Reel Script
prompts.prompt: Create a 30-45 second vertical video script for [TOPIC]. Hook in the first 2 seconds, use rapid but clear beats, visual changes, captions, and one CTA.

prompts.title: Storyboard
prompts.prompt: Create a storyboard for [VIDEO]. Break it into shots with visual composition, action, dialogue/narration, duration, transition, and continuity notes.

prompts.title: B-Roll Planner
prompts.prompt: Create a B-roll plan for [VIDEO/TOPIC]. List specific shots that support each narrative beat, including framing, movement, location, props, and transitions.

prompts.title: Video Editor
prompts.prompt: Create an editing plan for [FOOTAGE/VIDEO]. Define pacing, cut logic, music moments, sound design, captions, B-roll, transitions, and what to remove.

prompts.title: YouTube Outline
prompts.prompt: Build a YouTube video outline for [TOPIC]. Optimize for viewer value and retention: promise, cold open, sections, pattern interrupts, examples, payoff, and CTA.

prompts.title: Daily Priorities
prompts.prompt: Given [TASKS/CONSTRAINTS], choose today's three highest-impact priorities. Explain what to defer, sequence the work realistically, and include buffer for interruptions.

prompts.title: Project Breakdown
prompts.prompt: Break [PROJECT] into milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and next actions. Keep tasks concrete enough to execute and avoid unnecessary project-management overhead.

prompts.title: Inbox Triage
prompts.prompt: Triage [MESSAGES/TASKS] into do now, schedule, delegate, wait, or ignore. Prioritize by consequence and urgency rather than sender pressure.

prompts.title: Process Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Analyze this workflow: [PROCESS]. Identify bottlenecks, repeated work, unnecessary handoffs, automation opportunities, and the simplest improved process.

prompts.title: Focus Session
prompts.prompt: Design a [DURATION] focus session for [GOAL]. Define the exact outcome, preparation, work blocks, distractions to remove, checkpoints, and shutdown step.

prompts.title: Retrospective
prompts.prompt: Run a concise retrospective on [PROJECT/PERIOD]. Identify what worked, what failed, root causes, lessons, and the 1-3 changes most worth making next time.

prompts.title: Quiz Me
prompts.prompt: Quiz me on [TOPIC] at [LEVEL]. Ask one question at a time, wait for my answer, explain mistakes, adapt difficulty, and track the concepts I need to revisit.

prompts.title: Study Plan
prompts.prompt: Create a study plan for [SUBJECT] over [TIME]. Prioritize high-leverage concepts, active recall, spaced repetition, practice, and measurable checkpoints.

prompts.title: Flashcards
prompts.prompt: Turn [MATERIAL] into high-quality flashcards. Keep each card atomic, test understanding rather than recognition, avoid ambiguous questions, and include concise answers.

prompts.title: Practice Coach
prompts.prompt: Coach me through deliberate practice of [SKILL]. Give one exercise at a time, define success criteria, critique my attempt, and increase difficulty only when appropriate.

prompts.title: Concept Map
prompts.prompt: Create a concept map for [TOPIC]. Identify the central concepts, prerequisite relationships, cause/effect links, contrasts, and a recommended learning order.

prompts.title: Exam Prep
prompts.prompt: Prepare me for [EXAM] using [MATERIAL]. Identify likely high-value topics, test me actively, diagnose weak areas, and allocate remaining study time accordingly.

prompts.title: Pricing Strategist
prompts.prompt: Design a pricing approach for [PRODUCT]. Analyze customer value, alternatives, segmentation, packaging, willingness-to-pay evidence, risks, and experiments before final pricing.

prompts.title: Unit Economics
prompts.prompt: Analyze the unit economics of [BUSINESS] using [DATA]. Calculate or frame CAC, gross margin, contribution margin, retention, LTV, payback, and the assumptions that matter most.

prompts.title: Go-to-Market
prompts.prompt: Create a focused go-to-market plan for [PRODUCT] targeting [CUSTOMER]. Define wedge, positioning, acquisition motion, sales process, launch experiments, and leading metrics.

prompts.title: Business Model
prompts.prompt: Evaluate the business model for [IDEA]. Analyze who pays, why, revenue mechanics, cost drivers, distribution, defensibility, operational complexity, and failure modes.

prompts.title: Investor Memo
prompts.prompt: Turn [BUSINESS INFO] into a concise investor memo covering problem, solution, market, traction, business model, distribution, competition, team, risks, and ask.

prompts.title: Negotiation Prep
prompts.prompt: Prepare a negotiation strategy for [SITUATION]. Clarify objectives, BATNA, counterpart incentives, leverage, concessions, information gaps, opening position, and walk-away conditions.
